# the paths that run .github/workflows/web.yml (scripts/changed_paths.py decide)
# on.pull_request.paths of the workflow, when it has one, must list the same patterns in
# the same order (scripts/changed_paths.py sync)
# every file a job of the workflow executes or reads is listed: a missing one skips the
# job on a change that alters it
src/**
Cargo.toml
Cargo.lock
rust-toolchain.toml
# the wasm package is built from the facade
crates/alice-physics/**
scripts/build_wasm_pkg.sh
# the package build copies these into the package (a rename or a delete breaks npm run build)
README.md
LICENSE*
# the viewer, its lock file and the smoke test
web/**
# the changes and gate jobs
scripts/changed_paths.py
.github/workflows/web.yml
.github/paths/web.txt
